_source: Transcribed by hand from the box check comments of issues #16 (V8-Codex, codex-cli 0.160.1) and #28 (V8, Claude Code 2.1.290), run on the box on a private tmux server and a scratch folder. Not a pane capture: no capture files were saved by that check.

/model.inline_arg_note: `/model gpt-6-luna` was sent to the model as a prompt
/model.ran_end_to_end: pick a model, Enter, then s on the reasoning step

/permissions.ran_end_to_end: entry 2 picked, from an unrecorded cursor

/fast.bare: toggles the service tier and writes config.toml
/fast.inline_arg: `/fast status` was sent to the model as a prompt

messages.model_session_only: Model changed to gpt-6-luna medium for this session only
messages.permissions: Permission selection requested: Approve for me

/effort.picker: slider low..max, marker on the current level, Left/Right, s = this session only, Enter = default, Esc = cancel
/effort.ran_end_to_end: opened, read, cancelled; s seen in /model

/effort ultracode [on].message: Ultracode on (this session only): dynamic workflows on every task. Effort stays high.

/model.picker: numbered list that depends on the version

/fast.bare: opens a dialog that swallows keys
